note: Machine-readable failure modes. precheck.py runs hard_bans on every generated HTML before deployment. Warnings are injected into the critic prompt as scoring criteria.

hard_bans.description: OrbitControls.autoRotate=true — continuous Y-axis camera spin. Hard banned 2026-05-25 after bjk/mqo/9p0 violations.
hard_bans.fix: Set controls.autoRotate = false. Use a single slow non-Y drift or a fixed contemplative camera.

hard_bans.description: Per-frame random camera position jitter. Causes violent uncontrolled shaking. Hard banned 2026-05-25 after ibt violation.
hard_bans.fix: Use smooth sin/cos oscillation or a fixed camera. The one allowed exception is a deliberate bas-relief sand-shake narrative.

warnings.description: Bare Y-axis rotation increment — acceptable only if a reveal/morph/narrative happens during rotation (not just spin).
warnings.note: Flag for critic review. Hard-ban only if nothing interesting happens during the rotation.

warnings.description: Large per-frame rotation increment (>=0.02 rad/frame = fast). Pieces must feel unhurried.
warnings.note: Slow to <= 0.001-0.005 range for contemplative motion.

warnings.description: CSS hsl() color with saturation > 65%. Palette must be earth-toned (rust, dusk, ash, patina, bone, midnight, smoke).
warnings.note: Max HSL sat 45% preferred. Anything above 65% reads as neon/pop-art.
Three.js setHSL takes 0-1 range; >0.65 = vivid, use <=0.4 for earth-tones.

warnings.description: Pure fully-saturated primary or secondary hex colors — read as neon/pop-art.
Per-frame Math.random() noise added to particle/vertex positions without a clear narrative purpose.
warnings.note: Deterministic noise (simplex/fbm) is fine. Raw Math.random per-frame on positions is visual dirt.

render_gate.description: Pixel-level gate run by validate_render.py via Playwright. Separate from precheck — runs after disk write.
